aliases: Seeking feedback on work-management skills and professional relationships
banglaExplanation: Work relationships সামলানো আর নিজের professional performance নিয়ে feedback চাওয়া — সবার জন্য জরুরি skill।
তার চেয়েও বেশি জরুরি: পাওয়া feedback evaluate করা আর সেই অনুযায়ী act upon করা।
Feedback আসে ছয় জায়গা থেকে: নিজের ও অন্য প্রতিষ্ঠানের colleagues, enterprises, government, learners আর candidates।
এটি PC 3.2-এর সাথে মেলে: feedback obtained, evaluated and acted upon।

example.bn: Course শেষে garments trainer factory manager আর learners-এর feedback নিয়ে session plan বদলান।
example.en: After a course, a garments trainer asks the factory manager and learners for feedback. Then he improves his plan.

short.modelAnswer:
Seeking feedback is an essential skill. It is even more important to evaluate and act upon it. Feedback may come from:
1. colleagues from within your training and/or assessment organization
2. colleagues from other training and/or assessment organizations
3. clients from enterprises and industry sectors
4. clients from government departments, agencies and other external organizations
5. individual learners, employees, apprentices and trainees
6. candidates for assessment
